subject: Taxes
title: Why Billionaire Tax Stories Go Viral
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Why Billionaire Tax Stories Go Viral.

hook.text: When ProPublica revealed that Jeff Bezos paid zero income tax in 2007 and 2011.

buildup.text: Bezos's wealth grew by $99 billion from 2006 to 2018. His total tax bill was $973 million—an effective rate under 1%.

discovery.text: Psychologists call this the 'unfairness instinct.' Humans are wired to detect inequality.

twist.text: Bezos broke no laws. Unrealized gains aren't income.

climax.text: Billionaire tax stories go viral because they trigger our deepest fairness circuits.

punchline.text: $99 billion gained, under 1% paid. The unfairness instinct erupts.

quiz.question: Why did ProPublica's billionaire tax story go viral?
options: It triggered deep human instincts about fairness and free-riding
It was written by a celebrity
